== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
Both Set 8 publisher states use the Special Edition persona. The remaster moves capture from the just-initiated same-site window to during battle and names a target present with Boba Fett. It retains the ability threshold, Slave I pilot bonus and Han-or-Jabba immunity. The separately recovered Holotable file carries grappling-hook wording found in later Legacy, with a different Slave I bonus from the Legacy slip.
